connection_authentication.note: Integrity in .ziv is provided by the AES-GCM tag (AEAD), not by an HMAC; the catalog value has no MAC (AES-CBC + XML parse). No HMAC was traced to a connection-authentication purpose. The RestoreAccess Authorization header was not observed live, so connection authentication stays UNCONFIRMED.
connection_authentication.rule: The mere presence of an HMAC library or a Mac.init call confirms nothing. No key values and no hook inputs/outputs are stored in this dossier.
